alert-circle.note: Solar uses DangerCircle for Lucide's legacy AlertCircle alias.

alert-triangle.note: Solar uses DangerTriangle for Lucide's legacy AlertTriangle alias.

audio-lines.note: Solar Soundwave is the existing waveform equivalent for Lucide AudioLines.

check.note: The standalone Solar check mark is published as CheckRead.

check-circle-2.note: Lucide's legacy CheckCircle2 name maps to Solar CheckCircle.

circle-help.note: Solar uses QuestionCircle for the generic help circle.

circle-plus.note: Solar uses AddCircle for the circular add control.

circle-user.note: Solar uses UserCircle for the circular user control.

circle-user-round.note: The current Solar UserCircle is the closest available rounded-user candidate.

home.note: Lucide's legacy Home name is supported directly by Solar.

octagon-x.note: Solar has no octagonal frame yet; CloseSquare is the documented fallback. CloseCircle is an alternate fallback when a circular status treatment is preferred.

paintbrush.note: Solar's extended icon uses the canonical hyphenated name PaintBrush.

plus.note: Solar's extended add primitive is the canonical plus control.

settings-2.note: Solar SettingsMinimalistic is the closest two-slider settings control.

terminal-square.note: Solar Programming is the square terminal/programming mark.

users.note: The current Solar users-group-rounded icon preserves the generic users concept; the exact silhouette still needs visual review.

x.note: Solar's extended close primitive is the canonical X control.
